entries.title: John 10:1
segments: ¶"Most assuredly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

entries.title: John 10:2
segments: "But he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:3
segments: "To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

entries.title: John 10:4
segments: "And when he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

entries.title: John 10:5
segments: "Yet they will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers."

entries.title: John 10:6
segments: Jesus used this illustration, but they did not understand the things which He spoke to them.

entries.title: John 10:7
segments: Then Jesus said to them again, "Most assuredly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:8
segments: "All who [ever] came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.

entries.title: John 10:9
segments: "I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.

entries.title: John 10:10
segments: "The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have [it] more abundantly.

entries.title: John 10:11
segments: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:12
segments: "But a hireling, [he who is] not the shepherd, one who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf catches the sheep and scatters them.

entries.title: John 10:13
segments: "The hireling flees because he is a hireling and does not care about the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:14
segments: "I am the good shepherd; and I know My [sheep], and am known by My own.

entries.title: John 10:15
segments: "As the Father knows Me, even so I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:16
segments: "And other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they will hear My voice; and there will be one flock [and] one shepherd.

entries.title: John 10:17
segments: "Therefore My Father loves Me, because I lay down My life that I may take it again.

entries.title: John 10:18
segments: "No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of Myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This command I have received from My Father."

entries.title: John 10:19
segments: ¶Therefore there was a division again among the Jews because of these sayings.

entries.title: John 10:20
segments: And many of them said, "He has a demon and is mad. Why do you listen to Him?"

entries.title: John 10:21
segments: Others said, "These are not the words of one who has a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"

entries.title: John 10:22
segments: ¶Now it was the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, and it was winter.

entries.title: John 10:23
segments: And Jesus walked in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

entries.title: John 10:24
segments: Then the Jews surrounded Him and said to Him, "How long do You keep us in doubt? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."

entries.title: John 10:25
segments: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in My Father's name, they bear witness of Me.

entries.title: John 10:26
segments: "But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep, as I said to you.

entries.title: John 10:27
segments: "My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

entries.title: John 10:28
segments: "And I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; neither shall anyone snatch them out of My hand.

entries.title: John 10:29
segments: "My Father, who has given [them] to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch [them] out of My Father's hand.

entries.title: John 10:30
segments: "I and [My] Father are one."

entries.title: John 10:31
segments: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone Him.

entries.title: John 10:32
segments: Jesus answered them, "Many good works I have shown you from My Father. For which of those works do you stone Me?"

entries.title: John 10:33
segments: The Jews answered Him, saying, "For a good work we do not stone You, but for blasphemy, and because You, being a Man, make Yourself God."

entries.title: John 10:34
segments: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your law, 'I said, "You are gods"'?

entries.title: John 10:35
segments: "If He called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be broken),

entries.title: John 10:36
segments: "do you say of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You are blaspheming,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God'?

entries.title: John 10:37
segments: "If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;

entries.title: John 10:38
segments: "but if I do, though you do not believe Me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father [is] in Me, and I in Him."

entries.title: John 10:39
segments: ¶Therefore they sought again to seize Him, but He escaped out of their hand.

entries.title: John 10:40
segments: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and there He stayed.

entries.title: John 10:41
segments: Then many came to Him and said, "John performed no sign, but all the things that John spoke about this Man were true."

entries.title: John 10:42
segments: And many believed in Him there.
